content:
anna: Kicking off catalog enable for aegis-6b-v2 tonight in change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Canary plan: region-us-west-2 -> 1% -> 3% -> hold -> 10%. Pinlist updated for enterprise customers A/B. Please ack.

deploy-bot: Deploybot queued job catalog.rollout R-2026-0321-A by anna. Preflight checks running: model artifacts present, quant variant builds available, infra capacity check OK. ETA deploy 23:02 UTC.

jordan: ack — adding smoke eval set aegis_smoke_v1 (path: /mnt/evals/aegis_smoke_v1). Will run on each canary step.

ops-sre: Quick Q: What are explicit rollback triggers? Need thresholds to wire into alerting.

anna: Rollback conditions: p50 latency +20% sustained >5m OR error rate increase >1% absolute (or >200 rps error spikes). Also functional/regression check: if core eval drop >3% on smoke set -> rollback. Manual rollback allowed by ops/sre or product.

mike: On infra side, add memory-pressure fallback: prefer quant variant when host memory >85%. Can we make that part of fallback ordering?

sophia: I'll update the priority map. Proposed ordering: aegis-6b-v2 (full) > aegis-6b-quant (quant) > titan-13b (legacy). But note: that will prefer full model; we need a routing override for low-memory clients.

anna: Exactly — default prefer full unless request has tag `client:mobile-lowmem` or host-level memory constraint. Routing policy = `latency_then_cost` with override for `mobile-lowmem`.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: canary ramp plan summary: 0% -> 1% after start (t=0) -> 3% after 30m -> hold 30m -> 10% after successful hold. Auto-rollback enabled on breaches. Notifications to #eng-releases and #eng-sre.

jordan: Smoke run (initial): passed format/safety checks, small tokenization mismatch on date strings (different canonicalization). Filed issue #4567. No quality regressions observed in top-N outputs.

ops-sre: I'll be monitoring dashboards, traces, and token-level latency breakdowns. Ops oncall @mike — please be available during the window.

mike: Oncall ack. I'll watch infra metrics and be ready to flip rollback.

sophia: Pushed priority-map commit `cfg-priority-9876abc` which includes the `mobile-lowmem` override. Also set fallback TTL=60s, cache TTL=300s for canary.

anna: Reminder: pinned customers A/B are on the pinlist — if they show regressions we perform immediate rollback and revert pinlist.

jordan: Confirmed KV cache warming is disabled for canary to prevent cross-traffic contamination.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: preflight completed, all checks green. Proceeding to deploy at 23:02 UTC.

anna: Canary 1% now live (23:02). Observability: http://telemetry/redwood/canary/5267890123 (live metrics + smoke evals).

ops-sre: Saw a 0.5% uptick in p95 tokens for ~2 minutes, within tolerance window. No error increase.

jordan: Smoke eval after 10m: all core prompts OK; minor formatting note from #4567. Will re-run after 30m.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: ramp to 3% completed at 23:35.

mike: No infra alerts, memory stable. No retriable errors.

sophia: Verified fallback ordering in runtime: full -> quant -> legacy. Config is live.

anna: Hold completed, proceeding to 10% at 23:45 UTC per plan.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: rolling to 10% now. Auto-rollbacks remain armed.

jordan: Post-10% smoke run (after 30m): no quality regressions, latency profiles stable. Logging a follow-up PR to normalize date tokenization (#4568).

ops-sre: No sustained latency regressions, error rates flat. I've set a 15-minute increased sampling window for traces.

mike: All clear from infra.

sophia: Note for ops: if memory pressure occurs, quant variant will be selected by host policy; this is already in the routing config `host_memory_threshold = 85`.

anna: Great work team. Rollout at 10% with auto-fallback rules and pinlist in place. We'll continue to monitor and schedule the next ramp after tomorrow AM review. If anyone sees a regression for pinned customers, call immediate rollback.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: rollout to 10% complete. Job R-2026-0321-A marked `in-progress -> canary`. Will post final status after next ramp.

jordan: closing the smoke thread, will open follow-ups for tokenization normalization and post-roll telemetry queries.

anna: Closing this thread — thanks all. :party_parrot:
